scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=apps/api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/crawler --workspace=packages/parser --workspace=packages/embeddings
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
